name: default
description: Conservative generic gates. Used when no profile matches this machine.
notes: These are NOT calibrated to your hardware. They are a starting point.
Run a few models you already have opinions about, then edit the gates so the
verdicts match your lived experience. Copy this file to profiles/<yourbox>.json
and set match.gpu_contains (or match.host) so it auto-selects.
Thresholds are deliberately explained rather than magic -- change them.

fast_chat.why: comfortable human reading is ~5-6 tok/s; 10 gives headroom

interactive_coding.why: you skim code faster than prose

uncensored.why: finite screening pack of three named ordinary prompts; a pass means no refusal was observed in that pack, not that the model has a universal low-refusal rate

structured_output.why: structured output is a high-value damage probe because it can fail while ordinary prose remains superficially plausible; below ~3/4 valid a pipeline spends more time retrying than working

instruction_precision.why: verifiable constraints graded by code; persistent misses mean every prompt needs a retry wrapper

tool_calling.why: screening threshold for three clustered tool families. Nine perfect trials may remain inconclusive after family clustering; a production reliability requirement must select its own evidence plan, and more repeats of the same families do not automatically provide independent evidence

tool_restraint.why: screening threshold for three clustered irrelevance families. Firing a tool on a question no tool can answer burns a turn, but a production restraint requirement must select an evidence plan with enough independent scenarios

unattended_agentic.why: Longer agent histories increase repeated prompt processing. This gate measures observed prefill rather than assuming it dominates every loop.

always_on_capable.why: rough default; set this to roughly a third of your usable RAM

quality.why: Multiple independent signals -- a single metric misses cases. A looping table scored dup_paragraph_ratio 0.0 while dup_line_ratio was 0.91 and gzip CR 9.2. Gopher corpus thresholds (dup_line 0.30, top_4gram 0.16) are reused; gzip CR anchors: human prose ~2.28, model output 2.36-2.72, so >4.0 is plainly degenerate. Truncation is separate because it prevents completion and can accompany repetition.
